label: The operation respect of a moving is relevant to that moving
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: whenever y moves x in respect r and that moving is y's operation in y's own respect o, y's being moved in o (if it is) is relevant to its moving x in r (RelevantTo y x r o). On the lending (instrumental) reading of relevance the route needs (docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md), it says that y, being moved in o by some other thing, moves x in r by a power it has through that present being moved, as an instrument of its mover. Reaction from the patient x is not lending. It adds the relevance clause that lets the operation route (631e014f-685d-434c-86b7-4a683a507b4d or f03798ba-e9d8-5594-b354-81fb9e9048c0 with d791628f-72c6-572e-ad1e-03f4f22ba646 and 0628359b-4a71-5c67-a84b-0fd80104aceb) yield C* for caused movers.
